facts.fact: The Ministry of Finance (DGCI) deck says startups benefit from financial incentives, skills support and other institutional support provided in Law 70/VIII/2014 of 26 August.

The Ministry of Finance (DGCI) deck says the 2026 State Budget applies a 5% IRPC rate (2.5% for ICT startups and those outside Praia, Sal, Sao Vicente and Boa Vista) to startups for their first five years, with stamp-duty and import-duty relief.
